axis: esm2_t33_650M_full_finetune: continue training FROM trial-075's checkpoint (--resume-from-revision), same config unchanged - per user direction, trial-075's exact hyperparameters are the valid point to build the next beam-search stage on top of, not a fresh restart at a bigger data/epoch budget
note: trial-075 (unfreeze_last_n=27, batch_size=16, lr=2e-5, weight_decay=0.2, output_dropout=0.2, --no-gradient-checkpointing, bf16, A100) ran 8 epochs on 6000 train(resampled)/1000 val and finished HEALTHY - val_loss was still improving at the last epoch (0.0741->0.0733), no overfitting signature within that budget. Rather than restarting cold at a bigger data/epoch budget (trial-074's mirror approach on the LoRA side, which found only mild gains before overfitting past epoch 7), this trial resumes directly from trial-075's own weights via --resume-from-revision trial-075 --start-epoch 8 and trains 4 more epochs (9-12) on freshly-resampled 6000-train/1000-val data (build_train_dataloader seeds by args.seed+epoch, so epochs 9-12 use seeds 50-53, never touching epochs 0-7's seeds 42-49) - every other hyperparameter held byte-for-byte identical to trial-075. This answers the open question in beam_search_state.json's esm2_t33_650M_full_finetune next_step directly: does more training from this exact validated point keep improving, or does it hit the same overfitting wall trial-074 found on the LoRA side? Sized at trial-075's real measured throughput (2662.5s/56000 examples = 0.047545s/example): 4 epochs * 7000 examples/epoch * 0.047545s = ~1331s (~22.2min) + overhead (re-downloading trial-075's 650M checkpoint from the Hub, comparable to a fresh base-model download) -> --max-minutes 45 gives a generous buffer. --checkpoint-mode every-epoch given real A100 dollar stakes. Pushes to its own kelmoir/cafa6-esm@trial-076 branch (build_notebook.py's runner passes --checkpoint-branch trial-076), leaving the currently-promoted trial-075/main checkpoint untouched regardless of outcome. --push-to-hub deliberately NOT set - promote only if this beats trial-075 on best F1/median AUROC. --run-diagnostic is auto-appended by build_notebook.py.
